name: markdown
tagline_zh: 喂它一堆 .md 和 .txt，它榨出干净结构。别人只读标题，它连表格、代码块、引用都给你理顺，还能自动去重。
tagline_en: Feed it messy .md and .txt, get clean structure. It parses tables, code, quotes, and dedupes—more than just.
desc_en: Ingest Markdown and plain text files
why_zh: 同类只抽标题，它连表格、代码块、引用都理顺，还自动去重，省你半天清理功夫。
why_en: Others skim headings; it parses tables, code, quotes, and dedupes—saving you hours of cleanup.
